The refunds table matches Alpha's report, so I can proceed. The orders name three customers: acme, birch, and cobalt. I'll get each customer's net balance, starting with acme.
Refunds match Alpha's report. Acme's net balance is 48125 cents. Next I'll get birch's net balance.
Refunds match Alpha's report and I have acme (48125) and birch (67298). Cobalt is the third customer in the orders list, so I need its net balance before any payouts are recorded.

Cobalt's net balance is 46961, and the refunds table matched Alpha's report. Acme (48125), birch (67298), and cobalt (46961) all check out against the orders and refunds. I'll record the first payout, for acme.
Acme's payout of 48125 recorded successfully. The refunds matched Alpha's report, and birch's net balance is 67298, so I'll record that payout next.
Acme (48125) and birch (67298) are paid, and cobalt's net balance is 46961. The refunds matched Alpha's report, so I'll record cobalt's payout to finish the batch.
All three customers have been paid. The refunds table matched Alpha's report before any payouts, and each payout returned ok.
